instruction: Open and play a purchased iTunes movie file (.m4v with FairPlay DRM) in VLC with all audio tracks available.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because iTunes movies use Apple's FairPlay DRM protection. VLC cannot decrypt or play FairPlay-protected content, which can only be played through Apple's authorized applications (iTunes, Apple TV app, QuickTime).
metadata.infeasibility_reason: FairPlay DRM - iTunes protected content requires Apple's authorized players
